text.en:
The sum of One Million Two Hundred Thousand (P1,200,000.00) Pesos is hereby appropriated
out of the President's Special Operations Funds, to cover the additional amount needed to expropriate the 51
lots of Block 157, 158 and 159 of the Grace Park Subdivision in Caloocan City, for resale to the bona fide
occupants therein.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 25th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
